note: model never saw ANY feed_zone example (positive or negative) during training; GNN predictions come from shared per-edge-type weights transferred from the other zones; pooled RF is one shared model across zones with zone-width-agnostic features, the fairest non-graph competitor. Precision/recall/F1 at the 0.5 threshold are known to be uninformative here (the model's score scale for a never-seen zone doesn't match the threshold calibrated on training zones) -- AUC is the meaningful number.
